text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces errors. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees organise their work, manage schedules, and make faster decisions. However, AI does not replace people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming more common, as workers use smart systems to support their skills and creativity. These changes also affect jobs, because some roles disappear while new ones appear. This means employees need to learn new skills and adapt to modern workplaces. Overall, AI offers both opportunities and challenges, and success depends on how well people and technology work together.
